Image.help_how: One picture per field: drag it in or choose it, and it is kept when you save the form. A very large photo can be reduced before it is sent.

File.help_how: One file per field. Drag it in or choose it, and it is kept when you save the form.

Files.help_how: The files of this record, one per row, each with its description. Every gesture counts at once, without saving the form, and what you remove goes to the bin. A new record must be saved before its first file.

FilePath.label: File Path

columns.help: Unique login username

User.name: users
User.label: User

Author.name: authors
Author.help: A writer of the catalogue, with the dates and the biography.

columns.name: wikidata
columns.label: Wikidata
columns.help: The author's item on Wikidata, such as Q154756: it is how the biography is found.
columns.doc: The key the biography and the dates are looked up by, since a name is no key.

columns.name: bio
columns.label: Biography
columns.help: The text the Fetch biography command loads, which you can then change.

columns.name: documents
columns.help: What the library keeps about this author, such as contracts and letters.

Book.name: books
Book.help: A book of the catalogue, one row per title, with the data of this edition.
Book.doc:
One row per title. The library plugin adds the columns it needs to lend
and show a book (status, cover, sample) to this same table.

columns.name: original_title
columns.help: The title of the work, when this edition is a translation or carries another.

columns.name: first_published
columns.label: First published
columns.help: The year the work first came out, not the year of this edition.

columns.name: publication_date
columns.help: When this edition came out.

columns.name: language
columns.help: The language of this edition, as a two-letter code: en, it, fr.

columns.name: publisher_id
columns.label: Publisher
columns.help: The publisher of this edition.

columns.name: tags
columns.help: Tags separated by commas. The first one is the main genre.

columns.name: cover
columns.help: The picture of the cover. It can be uploaded before the book is saved.
columns.doc: Uploaded before the book is saved too, so book files lay out by date.

columns.name: sample
columns.label: Sample chapter
columns.help: A chapter to read, as a PDF. It opens in the browser.

indexes.name: idx_book_title_date
indexes.description: Search books by title and year

columns.name: notes
columns.help: A note on the part of this author in the book, such as translator or editor.

columns.name: phone
columns.help: Contact phone number

Review.help: What a reader thought of a book.
Review.name: reviews

columns.name: rating
columns.help: From one to five stars.

columns.name: book_id
columns.doc: A review is edited inside the book's form and still outlives it: lifetime and editing surface are independent axes, and saying so settles the question.

Loan.help: A book lent to a member, from the day it goes out to the day it comes back.
Loan.name: loans

columns.name: due_date
columns.help: When the book should come back.

columns.name: returned_at
columns.help: Empty while the book is out.

columns.name: book_id
columns.doc: A loan is a journal entry, edited inside the book's form behind a button and not a part of the book: deleting a book leaves its history standing.

PurchaseOrder.name: purchase_orders
PurchaseOrder.help: An order to one publisher for the books the library wants to buy.
PurchaseOrder.doc:
A bench for the document form (header, rows, phases, commands on the
rows), not a purchasing module: quantities are numbers and nothing counts
copies or stock.

columns.name: order_date
columns.label: Date
columns.help: The date of the order. A new order starts from the working date.
columns.doc: Not duplicated, because a copy is a new order with a date of its own.

columns.name: publisher_id
columns.label: Publisher
columns.help: The publisher the books are ordered from.

columns.name: supplier_reference
columns.label: Supplier reference
columns.help: The publisher's own reference: their quote, or the sheet they sent.

columns.name: expected_delivery
columns.label: Expected delivery
columns.help: When the books should arrive. It cannot come before the date of the order.

columns.name: footer_discount
columns.label: Discount on the order
columns.help: A discount on the whole order, beside the discount of each line.

columns.name: purchase_order_id
columns.doc: A part of its order, which goes when the order goes.

columns.name: sequence
columns.doc: The place of the row in its document, which the reader chose.

columns.name: book_id
columns.label: Book
columns.help: A book of the order's publisher.

columns.name: discount
columns.help: The discount on this line. A new line starts from the discount set in the header.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Leave it empty to keep the current one. A new user needs one.

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles
fields.help: A role brings the roles it implies, shown checked and greyed.

fields.name: acl_exceptions
fields.label: What this user may do
fields.help: The roles give the cells; a click forces one for this user alone, granted (+) or denied (-). A denial wins over the roles.

book_with_reviews.title: Books & Reviews
book_with_reviews.help: The catalogue with what readers did. Click a book to see its detail, its reviews and its loans.

book_list.title: Books
book_list.help: The catalogue. Open a book to read or change it, or add a new one.

book_form.title: Book
book_form.help: A book in one screen. What is read less often stays behind the buttons.

layout.label: Loans
layout.help: Who borrowed this book, and when. The button shows how many loans there are.

layout.label: Statistics
layout.help: Counts the loans of this book. The book must be saved first.

book_description_form.title: Description & tags
book_description_form.help: The same book with the fields read less often. Confirm brings them back to the form.

commands.label: Fetch biography
commands.help: Looks up the biography on Wikipedia, through the Wikidata item of the author.

props.title: Devtest, a Kitebase demo and playground
intro: The library is the working part: catalogue, members, loans and reviews. The Playground group holds the demos of panels, triggers, wizards and dialogs: those that read no table ask for playground.demos, which the librarian has.
Access control is on. Sign out and back in as another user to see what each role is given: the menu, the pages and the data follow the role.

users.sees: Everything: not a role, it passes every check.
The catalogue. No loans: the Loans tab of Book + reviews is not there.
Members and loans; books read only, every other table by its label.
Cataloguer and loans desk together, plus the reviews and the Playground demos.
Loan statistics, by book and by month. The Loans list answers 403: it shows the members' names. No Playground: the group goes when nothing in it is left.
Orders to the publishers and what arrives against them; the catalogue read only. The bench of the document form.

purchaseorder_list.title: Purchase orders
purchaseorder_list.help: The orders sent to the publishers, newest first. Open one to read or change it, or add a new one.

commands.label: Import from spreadsheet
commands.help:
Creates orders from a spreadsheet with one row per order line. The
columns are `order`, `publisher`, `isbn` and `quantity`, with `price`
and `discount` if you have them. The sheet is written whole or not at
all: if one order is refused, none is created.

commands.label: Duplicate
commands.help:
A new order from the selected one, with the same publisher. It asks
for the date, proposing a month after the original, and whether to
copy the lines. Nothing is written until you save.

purchaseorder_form.title: Purchase order
purchaseorder_form.help: An order is written in three steps, and each step is checked before you move on.

fields.name: default_discount
fields.label: Discount for new lines
fields.help: Proposed for the lines you add from now on. It starts from the purchasing settings and is not kept with the order.

commands.label: Discount on lines
commands.help: Sets the same discount on the ticked lines, or on all of them when none is ticked. Nothing is written until you save the order.

commands.label: Sort by publication date
commands.help: Puts all the lines in the order their books came out, oldest first. A book without a date goes last.

commands.label: Archive
commands.help: Chooses whether the list shows active, archived or all books, and archives or restores the selected one.

commands.label: Fetch description
commands.help: Looks up the description on Open Library by ISBN, and asks before replacing a text.

commands.label: Print ticket
commands.help: Prints the ticket of the selected loan again.
